modern: Either you live here and have already got used to it, or you are going away, and this was your own will; or you are dying and have done your duty. But besides these things there is nothing. Be cheerful, then.
original: Either thou livest here and hast already accustomed thyself to it, or thou art going away, and this was thy own will; or thou art dying and hast discharged thy duty. But besides these things there is nothing. Be of good cheer, then.
notification: Either you live here and have already got used to it, or you are going away, and this was your own will; or you are dying and have done your duty.
notification_original: Either thou livest here and hast already accustomed thyself to it, or thou art going away, and this was thy own will; or thou art dying and hast discharged thy duty.

explained.summary: There are only three possibilities. You stay where you are, and you’re already used to it. You leave, which was your own choice. Or you die, having done your duty. There’s nothing beyond these, so be cheerful. Marcus is shrinking the range of things to worry about down to a few options, each of them acceptable.
